name: rushd
description: Arabic-first personal finance assistant for tracking expenses, budgets, goals, and spending insights.

scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.cjs tailwind.config.cjs postcss.config.cjs vite.config.mjs vitest.config.ts scripts/visual-parity.cjs scripts/browser-smoke.cjs scripts/legacy-idb-proof.cjs scripts/capture-p00-baseline.cjs scripts/smoke-check.mjs scripts/font-license-guard.mjs scripts/production-source.mjs scripts/extract-p02-legacy.mjs scripts/p04d-rollback-harness.mjs tests/font-license-guard.test.mjs tests/i18n-parity.test.mjs tests/p02-build-contract.test.mjs tests/rollback/retirement-contract.test.mjs public/sw.js public/retire-rejected-shell.js src/main.ts src/app/i18n/contracts.ts src/data/legacy-v1/contracts.ts src/shared/contracts.ts src/application/bootstrap.js src/application/debug-test-bridge.js src/domain src/application/commands src/application/sync tests/domain tests/property src/data/v2 src/data/migration src/data/portability tests/data
scripts.test: node scripts/smoke-check.mjs && node tests/font-license-guard.test.mjs && node tests/pwa/icon-font-contract.test.mjs && node tests/i18n-parity.test.mjs && node tests/p02-build-contract.test.mjs && node tests/rollback/retirement-contract.test.mjs && node scripts/finance-rules.test.mjs && node scripts/p00-fixtures.test.mjs && node scripts/p00-characterization.test.mjs && node tests/p01-dangerous-mutations.test.mjs && node tests/p01-stability.test.mjs && node scripts/p00-artifact-guards.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-p00-baseline.mjs && vitest run tests/domain
scripts.test:data: vitest run --config tests/data/vitest.p04a.config.ts && node tests/data/candidate-experiment.mjs && node tests/data/p04b-persistence.mjs && node tests/data/p04c-persistence.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 RUSHD_SMOKE_ROOT=dist node scripts/browser-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:font: node tests/pwa/icon-font-contract.test.mjs && node tests/font-license-guard.test.mjs && npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node tests/pwa/font-boot-browser.mjs && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node tests/pwa/icon-font-subset-browser.mjs
scripts.test:pwa: node tests/pwa/static-checks.mjs && vitest run --config tests/pwa/vitest.p04d2.config.ts && node tests/pwa/p04-d2-browser.mjs
scripts.test:p04d3: node tests/application/p04-d3-routing.test.mjs && vitest run --config tests/pwa/vitest.p04d3.config.ts && node tests/pwa/p04-d3-browser.mjs
scripts.test:p04d5-upgrade: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node tests/pwa/p04-d5-sw-upgrade-browser.mjs
scripts.test:legacy-idb: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 RUSHD_LEGACY_IDB_ROOT=dist node scripts/legacy-idb-proof.cjs
scripts.test:rollback: node tests/rollback/retirement-contract.test.mjs && npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 RUSHD_ROLLBACK_REPEAT=2 node scripts/p04d-rollback-harness.mjs
scripts.parity:quick: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node scripts/visual-parity.cjs --profile quick --candidate dist
scripts.parity:full: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node scripts/visual-parity.cjs --profile full --candidate dist
scripts.parity:self-test: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node scripts/visual-parity.cjs --self-test --candidate dist
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser && npm run parity:self-test && npm run parity:quick
scripts.test:p04d4: node tests/application/p04-d-mutation-coverage.test.mjs && node tests/application/p04-d4-routing.test.mjs && vitest run --config tests/pwa/vitest.p04d4.config.ts && node tests/pwa/p04-d4-browser.mjs
